d: Planners are responsible to estimate a timescale for a project and to ensure that the outlined deadlines are met. They work closely with Setter Out, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Logistics to ensure a project runs on schedule and that material supplies are sufficient.
q: Bachelor's degree in engineering, Architecture, or Interior Design
3-5 years’ Experience in project planning, scheduling, and operations within the manufacturing or construction/fit-out industry
Worked on Extension of Time using different techniques
Baseline Schedules, updates, EVM, Weekly and monthly reports
Worked on Primavera P6, MS Project will be an advantage
Understanding the proper sequencing of the project
r: Assisting in the development of project timelines and detailed schedules for joinery and furniture manufacturing projects, from start to delivery
Learning to identify critical path activities, dependencies, and potential bottlenecks within the project lifecycle
Supporting the creation of baseline schedules, dashboards, and tracking reports to monitor project progress
Acting as a key interface between the Setting-Out department, Procurement, Production,Logistics, Project Management, and external clients/parties
Facilitating effective communication to ensure all stakeholders are aligned on project status, requirements, and deadlines
Assisting in managing project correspondence and documentation with external parties
Collaborating with the Material Engineer and Procurement team to understand material requirements, lead times, and delivery schedules
Supporting the follow-up and follow-through of orders with the Procurement department, escalating issues and tracking delivery dates
Supporting the preparation of weekly and monthly progress reports for management review
Assisting in tracking production progress and coordinating with the production team to resolve any communication or coordination issues
Learning to perceive project phases and plot dependencies on tracking reports to facilitate organized follow-through
Contributing to increasing team efficiency by providing operational and administrative support
Proposing and assisting in implementing innovations in procedures to enhance departmental functionality and output
